The response is accurate on every point I checked: the starting rent and GST treatment, the 1 March review date, the 3–5% CPI band in years 2–4, the uncapped year-5 market review with the year-4 floor, the 30-day dispute window, the 50/50 valuer cost split, the separately billed outgoings, and the 14-day notice rule. Its main simplification is "the difference is back-paid" for late notice, which is a fair reading of the guide. It covers everything a busy manager needs, including the key risk that year-5 rent is uncapped. The body is about 128 words including the title, so it is slightly over the 120-word limit, though it is close and reasonably tight. Some phrasing could be trimmed, but nothing is missing.

Score: 8
